 Kings at Bruins projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 17, 2026 
 Link copied 
 KINGS (5-11-2) at BRUINS (13-6-1) 
 7 p.m. ET; ABTV, NESN 
 Kings projected lineup 
 Alex Turcotte -- Alex Laferriere -- Adrian Kempe
 Kevin Fiala -- Quinton Byfield -- Mats Zuccarello
 Trevor Moore -- Erik Haula -- Joel Armia
 Andre Lee -- Scott Laughton -- Corey Perry
 Erik Gustafsson -- Brandt Clarke
 Joel Edmundson -- Drew Doughty
 Mikey Anderson -- Brian Dumoulin
 Darcy Kuemper
 Anton Forsberg
 Scratched: Artemi Panarin, Cody Ceci, Samuel Helenius 
 Injured: None 
 Bruins projected lineup 
 JJ Peterka -- Pavel Zacha -- David Pastrnak
 Michael Eyssiont -- Fraser Minten -- Morgan Geekie
 Casey Mittelstadt -- Elias Lindholm -- Marat Khusnutdinov
 Tanner Jeannot – Sean Kuraly -- Mark Kastelic
 Hampus Lindholm -- Charlie McAvoy
 Nikita Zadorov -- Will Borgen
 Mason Lohrei -- Connor Clifton 
 Michael DiPietro
 Jeremy Swayman
 Scratched: Matthew Poitras, Frederic Brunet, Jonathan Aspirot 
 Injured: James Hagens (back) 
 Status report 
 Gustafsson returns after missing three games with an undisclosed injury. He will replace Ceci on defense. … Panarin, a forward, is expected to miss his second consecutive game following the death of his grandfather. … Lohrei will play after being scratched for a 6-2 loss to the Minnesota Wild on Saturday. … Kuraly returns after three games as a healthy scratch.
